mapper.select: select count(*) filter (where cast(#{today} as date) > c.close_due) as close_overdue_cnt, count(*) filter (where cast(#{today} as date) <= c.close_due and c.status = 'OPEN' and cast(#{today} as date) > c.contain_due) as contain_overdue_cnt from qms_capa c where c.status not in ('CLOSED', 'CANCELLED')
select c.capa_no, c.title, c.close_due from qms_capa c where c.status not in ('CLOSED', 'CANCELLED') and cast(#{today} as date) > c.close_due order by c.close_due, c.capa_no limit #{limit}

select count(*) as open_cnt, count(*) filter (where h.insp_type = 'RECEIVE') as receive_cnt, count(*) filter (where h.occurred_at < #{waitedBefore}) as long_wait_cnt from qms_insp h where h.status = 'OPEN'

select h.insp_no, h.insp_type, i.item_cd, l.lot_no, h.occurred_at from qms_insp h join mst_item i on i.item_id = h.item_id join lot_master l on l.lot_id = h.lot_id where h.status = 'OPEN' order by h.occurred_at, h.insp_id limit #{limit}

select count(*) as open_cnt, count(*) filter (where n.status = 'PENDING') as pending_cnt, count(*) filter (where n.hold_yn = 'Y') as hold_cnt, count(*) filter (where n.defect_id is null) as no_defect_cnt from qms_ncr n where n.status in ('OPEN', 'PENDING')

select n.ncr_no, n.status, i.item_cd, l.lot_no, n.occurred_at from qms_ncr n join mst_item i on i.item_id = n.item_id join lot_master l on l.lot_id = n.lot_id where n.status in ('OPEN', 'PENDING') order by n.occurred_at, n.ncr_id limit #{limit}

select count(*) as open_cnt, coalesce(sum((select count(*) from qms_contain_lot cl where cl.contain_id = c.contain_id and cl.released_at is null)), 0) as held_lot_cnt from qms_contain c where c.status = 'OPEN'

select c.contain_no, i.item_cd, c.reason, (select count(*) from qms_contain_lot cl where cl.contain_id = c.contain_id and cl.released_at is null) as held_lot_cnt, c.created_at from qms_contain c join mst_item i on i.item_id = c.item_id where c.status = 'OPEN' order by c.created_at, c.contain_id limit #{limit}

select h.insp_no, e.rule_cd, i.item_cd, c.char_no, s.status = 'ACKED' as acked, s.occurred_at from qms_spc_event_state s join qms_spc_event e on e.event_id = s.event_id join qms_insp h on h.insp_id = e.insp_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = e.item_id join qms_char c on c.char_id = e.char_id where s.status in ('OPEN', 'ACKED') order by s.occurred_at desc, s.event_id desc limit #{limit}
